response: The surname Camarena is of Spanish origin, derived from the place name Camarín, a small town in the province of Cádiz. It is a diminutive form of the name Camarón, which means "little drum" or "drum." The Camarena family name has been found in various parts of Spain, particularly in Andalusia, and it is believed to have originated during the Moorish occupation of Spain.
